meta.title: Sunnsteel — Statues aren't born. They're carved.
meta.description: A workout tracker where every set becomes evidence: plan, log, and watch records, ranks and your history grow. Free to start.

hero.headline: Statues aren't born. They're <mark>carved</mark>.
hero.subline: Plan, log every set, and watch the work add up: records broken, ranks earned.
hero.install: Runs in your browser and installs on any phone, with no app store. <link>How to install</link>
hero.phoneLabel: Example of a live workout in Sunnsteel

plan.title: Build your routine, or start from a template
plan.body: Weekly or rotating schedules and rep ranges that progress on their own. With Pro, 8-week blocks and planned deloads.
plan.callout: {template} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} a week

train.title: Load the bar without the math
train.body: Your last numbers beside every set, a rest timer that starts itself, and warm-ups and plates worked out from your working weight.

measure.title: See what is really moving
measure.body: Strength by estimated 1RM, the muscles you trained each week on a body map, and your weight over time. With Pro, training signals that give numbers, never verdicts.

earn.title: Records, milestones and ranks you earn by training
earn.body: Every record is found in your sets. Milestones and {ranks} ranks reward showing up, never posting.

progression.title: Reach the top of your range. The weight goes up.
progression.body: When every set reaches the top of its rep range, your next workout adds one step, {step} unless you choose another. Fall short and the weight you lifted carries over.

rest.title: Rest that starts itself
rest.body: It starts when you mark a set done and tells you when it's over, even with the screen locked, once notifications are on (on iPhone, in the installed app).

supersets.title: Link exercises and train in rounds
supersets.body: Up to {max} exercises in a group, one set of each per round, each keeping its own weights and progression.

swap.title: Machine taken? Swap it for today.
swap.body: Close alternatives, ranked by movement and muscles. Your routine stays as it is unless you choose to update it.

map.title: Every set you log lands on the map
map.body: Weekly sets per muscle on a body map, front and back, with the number behind every color, and your estimated 1RM week by week.
map.planLine: {free} weeks free, up to {pro} with Pro.
map.empty: No muscle has sets this week.

plateaus.body: Lifts with no new best after several sessions, with the rule written above them.

signals.name: Training signals
signals.body: Effort, rep targets, declines and workouts over two weeks against the two before. A change is marked, never explained.

deload.name: Deload suggestion
deload.body: When a load signal holds, it proposes a lighter week with its dates. Nothing changes until you save it.

review.name: Training review
review.body: Pick a question and a few workouts. The answer describes your logs, cites every number from them and never guesses a cause.

ranks.heading: Ranks earned by consistency
ranks.body: {count} ranks, from {first} to {last}, earned by workouts across different weeks: attendance, never how much you lift or how often you post. Your rank dresses your profile, and you choose who sees it.
ranks.requirement: {workouts, plural, one {# workout} other {# workouts}} in {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# different weeks}}

templates.heading: Start with a program
templates.body: Three programs to start from, each opening as a draft you can change. The weights are yours to fill in: a template can't know your strength.

noneFit.title: None of these?
noneFit.advanced: The 8-week block is built in the same builder.

people.heading: Train with people
people.subline: Free, like everything you do in a workout.
people.name: Lu

activity.title: Follow people and see them train
activity.body: Workouts, records and milestones from people you follow, with {reactions} reactions and comments. There's nothing to post.
activity.entry: {name} finished {day} · {records, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}

partners.title: Train with partners
partners.body: Up to {max} partners. Each of you chooses what the other sees, and you can be told when a partner finishes a workout.

messages.title: Send what you trained
messages.body: One-to-one messages that can carry a routine, a workout, a record, a milestone or a month of training. People you don't follow can only send you a request, and only if you allow it.

privacy.title: You choose who sees each part
privacy.body: {count} parts of your profile, each set to Everyone, Followers or Only me. Block anyone, report anything, and delete your account or take your data with you whenever you want.
